name: eis-ui-render-react-16-floor
description: Install-only fixture holding the React 16.14 peer floor for jest.react16.config.js. Linked from the root devDependencies as `react-16-floor` (file:scripts/fixtures/react16-floor) so a plain `npm ci` installs it, nested here rather than hoisted, leaving the root react/react-dom on 18. Versions are pinned exactly so the floor cannot drift with a transitive bump. Nothing but this manifest belongs in this directory: the harness code lives one level up in scripts/fixtures/react-legacy/ so that the node_modules npm nests here cannot shadow its module resolution and mask a broken mapping.
